regime_summary: Global markets show resilience amid stabilizing interest rates and strong corporate earnings, favoring growth-oriented assets like AAPL.

analysis.Meaning: Investors are favoring equities and growth assets due to improved macroeconomic sentiment and liquidity conditions.

AAPL is trading near its 52-week high, with technical resistance at A$220.00 and support at A$205.00.
Investors may consider accumulating shares on pullbacks, targeting entry points near A$205.00.
